items.html: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;
For the truth's sake, which dwelleth in us, and shall be with us for ever.
Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

blocks.html:
From the elder to the elect lady and her children,

whom I love in the truth.

items.html: I rejoiced greatly that I found of thy children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father.
And now I beseech thee, lady not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
And this is love, that we walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, That, as ye have heard from the beginning, ye should walk in it.

blocks.html:
Now I beg you, lady,

not as though this is a new commandment,

but as one we had from the beginning:

Love one another. [1]

items.html: For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.
Look to yourselves, that we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive a full reward.

blocks.html:
There are many deceivers

who deny that Jesus has come in the flesh.

Anyone who says this is a deceiver and an antichrist. [2]

items.html: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.

blocks.html:
Whoever doesn't accept the doctrine of Christ,

doesn't have God. [3]

Whoever accepts it, has both the Father and the Son.

items.html: If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him God speed:

blocks.html:
So if anyone doesn't bring this doctrine,

don't welcome them into your house or wish them well. [4]

items.html: For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds.

blocks.html:
Anyone who associates with them

is guilty of their evil deeds.

items.html: Having many things to write unto you, I would not write with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.

blocks.html: I have much more to say, but I'll wait until I see you again.

items.html: The children of thy elect sister greet thee. Amen.

blocks.html:
The children of your elect sister send their regards.

Amen.

footnotes.html:
Love one another. (v.5)

Except for antichrists. Stay the hell away from them. (See v. 7)

Many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist. (v.7)

Those who deny Jesus has come in the flesh (had a human body) are antichrists.

Whosoever ... abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. (v.9)

What the Bible says about non-Christians

If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him God speed. (v.10)

Don't associate with non-Christians. Don't receive them into your house or even exchange greeting with them. This is the biblical justification for "Disfellowshipping" among the Jehovah's Witnesses.
